records.Name: Sunny Bay Station
records.Information: Sitting on Sunny Avenue next to an emerging mixed‑use neighborhood, this station may not be right on central Golden Beach, but the yachting and speedboat options at the nearby Albatross Wharf make it a handy spot for locals and tourists alike. Expect mostly commuters during rush hour.

records.Name: Rixxy Wonderland
records.Information: This station offers direct access to a notable city landmark—Rixxy Wonderland, itself located right next to Golden Beach. It’s a popular vacation spot for both local families and visiting tourists. Visitors are advised to remain aware of their belongings as well as final train times.

records.Name: Freshville Station
records.Information: One of the first subway stations built in Nova City. This station provides access to Marine MechWorks, Portview Market, and Luminary Academy.

records.Name: Glimmergold
records.Information: You can reach Glimmergold Lane, VitalWorks Chemicals, and Veritas Institute from here. It’s buzzing 24/7, second only to the Citylink Station.

records.Name: Memorial Park
records.Information: Direct access to Skyfall Memorial Park, a hot tourist spot in Downtown East, honoring Nova heroes.

records.Name: Azure North Station
records.Information: This station is situated directly in the center of the tech and finance sector, giving you access to Aerie Bank, Nova TV Station, and various shopping malls. It’s also one of the key commuter stations.

records.Name: Future Port Station
records.Information: This station provides access to the Pop Cool Center, Crystal Plaza, and Albatross Wharf, all of which are currently under construction. Passengers heading to the beach can get off here as well.

records.Name: Coastal Station
records.Information: For Champion Stadium, Floramoon Park, and Mi Mall. It also serves passengers heading to the Ferris Wheel.

records.Name: Vista Station
records.Information: Welcome to the Vista Hub, where you can reach Aerie Bank, Nova City Bank, Saturn Tower, and Albatross Wharf. Passengers needing financial or banking services may alight here.

records.Name: Veluxity Station
records.Information: For Greenwave Residences, Paradox Plaza, and Freshville Commercial. Passengers heading to the seaside are advised to avoid peak hours.

records.Name: Paradox Plaza Station
records.Information: This station is adjacent to Paradox Extreme Sports Park and Skate Plaza, and is a hotspot for all the young trendsetters. Visitors are encouraged to keep their personal belongings secure and not to roll solo after dark.

records.Name: Marine MechWorks Station
records.Information: This station is located inside the industrial center of the city, which features major enterprises like machinery manufacturing and logistics. It can become extremely congested during rush hour, so please have your ID badge ready and exit the station in an orderly fashion.

records.Name: Beachside Bungalow
records.Information: Live the easy life, in a vibrant community, with Reign Real Estate apartments.

records.Name: Nova City Airport
records.Information: Nova City International Airport. The runway stretches onto the horizon, and beyond that lies your destination.

records.Name: DK9 HQ
records.Information: An abandoned baseball field where Garm grew up, and the last remaining territory of Fenrir, head of the Demons. It is now the HQ for Garm’s DK9.

records.Name: 绿屿公馆
records.Information: 以温润木质与繁茂绿意构筑的复古风情宅邸。细腻雕花与柔和线条交织，自成一座静谧又生机盎然的岛屿。
records.__RAW__Information: 以温润木质与繁茂绿意构筑的复古风情宅邸。细腻雕花与柔和线条交织，自成一座静谧又生机盎然的岛屿。

records.Name: 旧物仓公寓
records.Information: 由工业仓库改造而成的特色住宅，开敞空间通透随性，原质感墙面与复古街机元素相融，随性又潮流。
records.__RAW__Information: 由工业仓库改造而成的特色住宅，开敞空间通透随性，原质感墙面与复古街机元素相融，随性又潮流。

records.Name: 观澜北岸
records.Information: 开阔视野与利落线条交织的现代风格住宅，超大落地窗引光入室，铺陈出沉稳而自由的生活主场。
records.__RAW__Information: 开阔视野与利落线条交织的现代风格住宅，超大落地窗引光入室，铺陈出沉稳而自由的生活主场。

records.Name: 素光小筑
records.Information: 由原质木色与柔光织就的简约居所，木梁格栅与留白墙壁相映，提供一处安静的栖心之地。
records.__RAW__Information: 由原质木色与柔光织就的简约居所，木梁格栅与留白墙壁相映，提供一处安静的栖心之地。

records.Name: Dinglan North Road
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the Westside District residential area and the waterfront commercial zone. Of all the stations in the commercial district, this one is the most active at night.

records.Name: Zhaohua Road
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the Westside District residential area. All Lingyun City residents pass through here on their way to work, making it rank first in commuter traffic among all residential-district stations.

records.Name: Dinglan Road
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the N.8 Complex, with the Weilan Lake scenic area only a few minutes’ walk away and Lingyun City’s famous sights right before you. Shopping, food, and lake views all in one stop.

records.Name: Lakeside Pedestrian Street
records.Information: Stepping out of this station puts you at Weilan Lakeside Pedestrian Street, a popular family-friendly tourist destination. Stroll along the lake and take in the picturesque scenery, but be sure to plan ahead when traveling on holidays.

records.Name: Zenith Center
records.Information: This station connects directly to Zenith Tower, one of Lingyun City’s landmark buildings. Visitors can head to Zenith Park to experience interacting with robots.

records.Name: Lakeside South Road
records.Information: From this station you can reach the lakeside residential area. While located adjacent to Dinglan Road, it nevertheless retains its own sense of community. Live by the water and enjoy the easy life.

records.Name: Great Ferry Port
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the East Harbor District entrance, the port freight center, and the industrial park. It is Lingyun City’s trade hub.

records.Name: Xinfeng Road
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the city’s business district, lined with modern office towers and a gathering place for career-focused elites.

records.Name: Yaojin Road
records.Information: From this station, you can reach one of Lingyun City’s largest commercial districts, where brands of every kind can be found among the bustling streets.

records.Name: Yaojin Pedestrian Street
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the Yaojin Pedestrian Street and the Ocean Tide Theater, making for a blend of commerce and culture. Shopping, dining, and artistic performances are all on offer here.

records.Name: Mingchun North
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the banks of the Mingchun River. Stroll the riverside and have a quiet moment in the otherwise bustling city.

records.Name: Lakefront Institute
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the Lakefront Institute and the New Horizon Youth Center, which brim with youthful fervor and a strong academic atmosphere. Free rides are available with a student ID.

records.Name: Yanli Lane
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the Yanli Lane food street, Xiangnong Market, the morning-market strip, and more. All manner of culinary surprises wait around every corner, making it a real paradise for adventurous foodies.

records.Name: Lingjing Supervisory Agency
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the Lingjing Supervisory Agency (LSA), Lingyun City’s professional Chaos management institution. It serves every citizen suffering from Chaos-related troubles.

records.Name: Qijin Lane
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the Qijin Lane commercial street, where you can really take in the city’s distinctive sense of style.

records.Name: Diurnal Port
records.Information: From this station, you can reach Lingyun City’s most dazzling nightlife landmark, the Diurnal Port entertainment zone. Amid the brilliant lights, take in the luxurious nocturnal urban landscape.

records.Name: Lingyun Pier
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the City Observation Deck, the Lingyun Grand Theater, the Riptide Hotel, and more. Climb high for sweeping views of the diverse skyline.

records.Name: Bachong Pagoda
records.Information: From this station, you can reach Huiming Temple and Bachong Pagoda. Amid the spiritual charm of the ancient temple and curling incense smoke, gaze out at Weilan Lake and feel the blend of historic and modern urban architecture.

records.Name: Longqi Village
records.Information: From this station, you can reach Longqi Village. Tour the elegant mountain dwellings, savor tea and conversation, and return to nature in this secluded haven.

records.Name: 场地赛车场
records.Information: 环山赛道。

records.Name: Jeiqing Dike
records.Information: From this station, you can reach Jeiqing Dike. Visit a teahouse, or row a boat across Weilan Lake in this place which is the ultimate embodiment of slow living.

records.Name: Hermit Hill Trail
records.Information: From this station, you can reach Yinshan Studio, Zhiwei House, Ganquan Tea House, and more, offering a sublime intersection of art and cuisine.

records.Name: 山区赛车场
records.Information: 环山赛道。

records.Name: Cloudstream West Road
records.Information: From this station, you can reach the high-tech economic zone south of Zenith Center, the bustling hub of the new business-centered city and a powerful driving force for Lingyun City’s future.
